items.docs: Returns a sample upload payload for the campaign, describing the field names and campaign identifier needed to send records correctly.

info.name: Query campaign status and retrieve finalized records

params.name: slug
params.description: Campaign slug/identifier on the LeadGenius platform.

params.name: id
params.description: Return only the record(s) with the assigned ID. Repeat the parameter to request several ids (?id=1&id=2).

params.name: finalized_from
params.description: Filter records by date of finalization (from). Formats 2022-01-02 or 2022-01-03T18:03:11Z.

params.name: finalized_to
params.description: Filter records by date of finalization (to). Formats 2022-01-02 or 2022-01-03T18:03:11Z.

items.docs: Query a running job to find out the status of an API campaign. If the campaign has been completed you receive the completed data. Results are paginated at 100 records.
